title: AgentStep Loop with Fake Model
description: Pydantic AgentStep validates each model turn with thought, action, argument, done flag, and final_answer; fake model replays four replies including one invalid.

steps.description: Purpose: P7 validates a step-budgeted agent loop with Pydantic.
AgentStep model: fields for thought, action, argument, done, final_answer with validation rule.
Validator: done=true requires action='none' and a final_answer, enforced in code.
Tools: days_until and calculator functions with safety checks.
Script: four pre-written model replies, second one breaks the done rule.
Run_agent: loop validates each step, rejects invalid ones, executes tools, tracks budget.
Execution: runs agent with study hours question and prints results.
